**EVALUATION OF STATE INTEGRALS AT RATIONAL POINTS**

*STA VROS GAROUF ALIDIS AND RINAT KASHAEV*

18 pp, 12 sections.

**Abstract.** Multi-dimensional state-integrals of products of Faddeev’s quant um diloga- rithms arise frequently in Quantum Topology, quantum Teichm¨ uller t heory and complex Chern–Simons theory. Using the quasi-periodicity property of the quantum dilogarithm, we evaluate 1-dimensional state-integrals at rational points and exp ress the answer in terms of the Rogers dilogarithm, the cyclic (quantum) dilogarithm and ﬁnite st ate-sums at roots of unity. We illustrate our results with the evaluation of the state-inte grals of the 4 1, 5 2 and (−2,3,7) pretzel knots at rational points.
